note: Approximate download sizes for Windows x64 / Python 3.13 wheels, measured for the pinned versions. Model files are NOT part of any pack: each model shows its own size and license and asks before downloading.

cpu.label: AI Engine Pack - CPU
cpu.summary: For laptops and PCs without a supported GPU. Speech, translation, vision and face tools run on the processor (slower, but works everywhere).

directml.label: AI Engine Pack - CPU + DirectML
directml.summary: For Windows PCs with Intel or AMD graphics. Same as the CPU pack, but face tools use the graphics chip through DirectML.

gpu.label: AI Engine Pack - NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 12.6)
gpu.summary: For NVIDIA GPUs with at least 6 GB of video memory. Speech, vision and face tools run on the GPU. Includes the opt-in cloud clients.

items.name: PyTorch (CPU build) with torchvision and torchaudio
items.purpose: Runs Whisper speech recognition and vision captioning on the processor.

items.name: PyTorch (CUDA 12.6 build) with torchvision and torchaudio
items.purpose: Runs Whisper speech recognition and vision captioning on the NVIDIA GPU. Includes NVIDIA CUDA runtime libraries.
items.license: BSD-3-Clause (bundled NVIDIA CUDA libraries: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit EULA)

items.name: ONNX Runtime (CPU)
items.purpose: Runs the face analysis and face swap models.

items.name: ONNX Runtime (DirectML)
items.purpose: Runs the face analysis and face swap models on Intel/AMD graphics.

items.name: ONNX Runtime (CUDA) with NVIDIA CUDA & cuDNN runtime
items.purpose: Runs the face analysis and face swap models on the NVIDIA GPU.
items.license: MIT (bundled NVIDIA CUDA/cuDNN libraries: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit EULA)

items.name: OpenAI Whisper and stable-ts (with numba / llvmlite)
items.purpose: Local transcription, subtitles and word-level lyric alignment.

items.name: Hugging Face Transformers, Tokenizers and Hub client
InsightFace library with ONNX, SciPy and scikit-image
items.purpose: Face detection and face swap. The library code is MIT; the InsightFace models are for non-commercial use and are downloaded separately with their own notice.

items.name: llama-cpp-python (CPU build)
items.purpose: Built-in offline engine for the Helper and translation on laptops (no Ollama needed).

items.name: keyring and psutil
items.purpose: Stores cloud API keys in Windows Credential Manager; reads memory and hardware information.

items.name: Other shared dependencies (sympy, rich, typer, setuptools, ...)
items.purpose: Support libraries required by the packages above.

items.name: fal.ai and Google Gen AI clients
items.purpose: Opt-in cloud features (Kling motion, LivePortrait, Gemini image edit). Never used unless you add your own key and choose a cloud action.
